deviations.reason: KEEPFILTERS outside a CALCULATE filter argument or a table-scanning function argument (COUNTROWS(KEEPFILTERS(...))) is an error in Desktop; DashCraft evaluates its table argument.
IGNORE outside SUMMARIZECOLUMNS is an error in Desktop; DashCraft evaluates its argument.
CROSSFILTER(..., OneWay_LeftFiltersRight) naming the many side so that only the many side filters the one side is an error in Desktop; DashCraft applies the direction.

The implied ALLSELECTED of OFFSET/WINDOW outside any iteration keeps the outer CALCULATE filters in Desktop; DashCraft restores the query's root filter context (the ALLSELECTED shadow is the root filter, pbi-dax eval/context.rs). Needs shadow filter contexts per CALCULATE.

A floating-point SUM over Orders[Line Amount]: VertiPaq adds in segment order, DashCraft in row order, so the 15th significant digit differs (894300.500000003 vs 894300.500000001). The values agree within 1e-14 relative; FORMAT with General shows all 15 digits.

A field-parameter column (its groupByColumns make a composite key with Parameter Fields) cannot be aggregated alone in Desktop ('part of composite key'); DashCraft does not read groupByColumns and aggregates it.
